_comment: Adversarial fixture, deliberately named after the real 2026-08-25 collision: int_prelude/wilson.rs already declares Nat.inverseIndex (the modular inverse index from Wilson's theorem) into the Nat namespace from the Int prelude. This fixture's own construction is unrelated and irrelevant -- the point is that the NAME is already taken elsewhere in the real kernel environment, which a check scoped to this file or to nat_prelude/ alone cannot see. The generator's cross-prelude guard must refuse this BEFORE any kernel construction is attempted, by comparing against the full environment name snapshot, not against this spec corpus alone.
